'''Coria''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces division]] and the commanding officer of the [[Safecrackers]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

Coria and his unit were extracted from [[Quesh]] by [[Havoc Squad]] and participated in the successful infiltration and sabotage of the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|Gauntlet]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] in [[3641 BBY]].
